results.title: Double Barrel
results.overview: A thirst for power pulls Surya into a deadly rivalry. But once the violence begins, is there any way back?

results.title: If Pigeons Turned to Gold
results.original_title: Kdyby se holubi proměnili ve zlato
results.overview: Alcohol addiction is a constant in Pepa Lubojacki’s family. In an attempt to find a sisterly-brotherly way of dealing with it, text, long-term observation, beats and AI-animated photos are combined into an unflinching, yet loving form of disclosure.

results.title: Fuxi: Four Tales of Feasting
results.overview: Across four millennia, Sun and Moon witness four tales of feasting: from a prehistoric ancestor’s funeral to a mythic king’s spring rite, from a legendary exiled littérateur’s banquet to a waif’s birthday on the eve of modern revolution, where the living and the dead, gods and ghosts gather to savour the everyday joy of food.

results.title: La llama que llama: el documental
results.original_title: La llama que llama: el documental
results.overview: An insight into one of Argentina's most famous marketing campaigns of the late 1990s and early 2000s: la llama que llama. Their creators talk about their creation on its 25th anniversary.

results.title: Ridiculous Loves
results.overview: Six tragicomic stories of obsession and madness, centered on the paradox of love.

results.title: The Circle of Death 2
results.overview: Orgil lives with his elderly father and two children. Their family lives peacefully, but his father suffers from Alzheimer's disease. Orgil gives his father wartime items, such as an overcoat, a whistle, and a painting, hoping that they will help him regain his sanity. When the old man blows the bloody whistle among them, unexplained and terrifying events begin in Orgil's life.

results.title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
results.original_title: Jeff Arcuri: Nice to Meet You
results.overview: Jeff Arcuri's rapid-fire wit is nonstop as he balances outrageous jokes with heartfelt reflections on making his wife laugh during her cancer journey.

results.title: Nevrose
results.overview: Consumed by guilt after her daughter's death, a doctor becomes obsessed with saving lives. Everything changes when she crosses paths with a woman attempting suicide who does not want to be saved.

results.title: Gedwongen Geloften
results.overview: Documentary about sexual violence and forced marriage, focusing on women who were coerced, abducted or imprisoned by their own families. Central figure is Dutch-Pakistani human rights activist Shirin Musa (Femmes for Freedom), tirelessly fighting for their rights.

results.title: My Enemy, My Body
results.overview: Diagnosed with ALS (Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis), artist Juan Secaira faces the inexorable deterioration of his body by taking refuge in painting, poetry, and the company of his family.

results.title: Wish You Well
results.overview: Emotional blogger Zhu Junhao and marriage registrar Gong Xi—two love experts—divorce then agree to set each other up; this absurd experiment makes them rethink love and marriage, shifting from self-centeredness to seeking common ground and prioritizing "our happiness."

results.title: Pinjar
results.overview: ‘Pinjar’ is an evocative meditation on captivity—of bodies, of spirits, of choices—unfolding through the entangled lives of five individuals and a wild bird.

results.title: Lateral Thinking
results.overview: Psychologist Julia is kidnapped and taken to an abandoned factory on the outskirts of the city by a group of men convinced that she has the information they need to carry out a crime. As the days go by, Julia begins treating them as patients to try to analyze them and be able to get out alive. Behind her kidnapping, there are deep secrets that the psychologist doesn't know and will make her connect with a wild and unknown aspect.

results.title: Cuntri
results.overview: When his cat disappears, Tomi, a boy from a gated community, climbs over the fence to look for it. On the other side, he meets Juan, a poor boy, and together they embark on a search that brings them face to face with risks and unexpected discoveries.

results.title: Death O Lantern 4: Summer Slaughter
results.overview: Stingy Jack returns to wreak his pumpkinny havoc, but this time he's reborn through an unsuspecting descendant in the HEAT of the Summer. By the end of the carnage, it's Rose, our Hero Vs. Stingy Jack  for total supremacy!

results.title: Entre Líneas
results.overview: Just days before the premiere of a play, Pablo—an actor reeling from a breakup—finds himself in the grip of a creative crisis that prevents him from performing a pivotal scene. As he attempts to rehearse, memories of his ex-partner, Carolina, flood his mind, forcing him to relive their final conversation. He then realizes that the true conflict lies not in the script, but in the words he never dared to speak.

results.title: Pull
results.overview: When a young girl with lethal abilities tries to help the woman who raised her, her good intentions result in catastrophic violence.

results.title: Macy Murdoch: A Murder Rewritten
results.overview: When a mysterious rival uses a time machine to frame famous Edwardian-era Detective William Murdoch of a murder he didn’t commit, Macy Murdoch and her friends travel back to 1910 to determine the real perpetrator of the crime.

results.title: Lars Wallin - The Prince of Glamour
results.original_title: Lars Wallin - The Prince of Glamour
results.overview: Gala gowns, passion, discipline, magic, glitter, sweat, and tears. A film about fashion designer Lars Wallin, one of Sweden’s most celebrated couturiers.

results.title: My Dinner With Victor
results.overview: Two childhood friends meet after a long absence, but a cultural mix-up leads to hilarious – and deadly – consequences.
